name: turboexpander_laval_wheel
title: Turbo-expander: isentropic nozzle and Laval wheel (exercise)
summary: Steady model of a turbo-expander: an ideal isentropic nozzle followed by a Laval wheel. The throat pressure is the greater of the critical pressure and the exit pressure. The model computes the equivalent-section mass flow and the wheel power.

verification.summary: Compared with the stored solution of MSTh-SB-R4-Ex1.EES. compare_solution.py: 27 common variables, 9 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 1. Maximum relative difference 2.75e-01 on s_su (Air entropy reference, CoolSolve - EES = -1814 J/kg-K). Wheel power 106631 W versus 106362 W.
verification.reference: EES stored solution in MSTh-SB-R4-Ex1.EES (EES X7.458)
verification.notes: 27 common variables. The tool prints 2.75e-01 on s_su; the exact ratio is 0.2751831696. The extra CoolSolve name is pi, the built-in in U = pi*d_laval*N, not an unknown.
